headline: CEO & Co-Founder @ Patterno - Tenders. From weeks to minutes.
key_experience: Chief of Staff at CITO (May 2025 - Jul 2025)

recent_posts.text: Since December 1st, we are part of the nextMedia.Hamburg program, including 6 months of free workstations at @SPACE and direct access to Hamburg's innovation network. An incredible environment for building!

Builder Lounge, OpenAI's first-ever startup event in DACH. Yesterday in Munich. What stood out: OpenAI's team was genuinely curious about what we're building and where current models hit their limits. Not just offering API access but actually interested in solving problems together.

Meet Patterno at the HARBOUR FOUNDER SUMMIT! We're excited to be selected from 85+ applicants as one of six startups of the Startup World Cup pitching live on stage this Saturday. At our booth, we'll showcase how modern procurement teams identify, qualify, and prioritize relevant tenders.

Der Mythos vom 'billigsten Anbieter'. Warum die Hälfte der öffentlichen Aufträge anders vergeben wird! Weniger als die Hälfte der großen Ausschreibungen in Deutschland wird rein nach dem Preiskriterium vergeben. Das Prinzip des 'wirtschaftlich günstigsten Angebots' (MEAT) setzt sich immer mehr durch.

Wir suchen eine:n Founders Associate (Praktikant:in) @ Patterno AI. Hamburg. Start: 15. Januar / 1. Februar 2026. Dauer: 4-6 Monate. Patterno baut den Real-Time Intelligence Layer, der Unternehmen hilft, um die Ecke zu denken – globale Signale werden zu proaktiven Geschäftsentscheidungen.

key_interests: AI and automation in business processes
company_focus: Patterno automates tender processes, transforming weeks of work into minutes using AI. Focus on public procurement efficiency and helping companies navigate the €2T public procurement market.
